## Type of change / 改动类型

- [ ] Typo / formatting fix / 笔误或排版
- [ ] Correction to a derivation / answer / 纠正推导或答案
- [ ] Improved explanation / 改进讲解
- [ ] New solution / 新增解答
- [ ] Translation / 翻译
- [ ] Documentation (README / index / templates) / 文档（README / 索引 / 模板）

## Related issue / 关联 issue

<!-- e.g. Closes #12 / 例如 Closes #12 -->

## Checklist / 检查清单

- [ ] I did **not** modify any existing solution's core reasoning (additive change only) / 未改写既有解答的核心推理（仅叠加式改动）
- [ ] I did **not** add a build system, Makefile, or test harness / 未添加构建系统、Makefile 或测试框架
- [ ] File naming follows `<chapter>-<problem>.{c|md}` / 文件命名遵循 `<章>-<题号>.{c|md}`
- [ ] I opened an issue first for any substantive change / 较大改动已先开 issue
